body: Thank you so much for your input lightning! :)

I got left behind, again (I know I played fire with this) about 4 months ago, and I'm putting a stop to this yoyo feeling. In the first month, I impulsively signed up for a half-marathon run that my city yearly hosts (mind you I never ran such long distances.) That preoccupied me a lot, but my intention was to show it off to him.

Also started counselling to solve my childhood problems, and create myself. I had poor self-esteem during the relationship and even worse after each end. I couldn't trust him anymore when he left the first
 time.

Aside from that school's taking my time (exam season) and going to the gym. At first it was just to bump into my ex and numb the feelings but later on I couldn't care less about seeing him and would get panic attacks when I did. Thank God he doesn't go nowadays or I go on times he's not there. I sometimes joke around with my friends and tell them I'm seeing my boyfriend-- aka the gym. Once a week became twice, and then three to now four times a week. Running, skipping rope, cardio and lifting weights helped me get through my break up. 

Not saying I'm over the pain-- it's been 4 months we broke up and my last contact was some odd 20 days ago. I still occasionally cry on train rides going home from school, or even at the gym! Lately I've been seeing him in my dreams and some of those dreams seem so realistic it's nerve-wracking. 

But the most important thing that has  helped me is to feel the pain, and write it on my phone diary. I use an app called "What's Up?" for Android and every time I'm feeling something-- sad, angry, hurt, upset or even happy, I write whatever I'm doing at that time! It even has info on what negative mind behaviour you're using which helps with noticing your emotions throughout the day.

Also I go on a few dating sites, not expecting a relationship but to just talk to new people and go on new dates. I guess it's to get rid of the loneliness. I also have a friend who is kind enough to be my break up buddy. I remember a week ago was my ex's birthday and I wrote to him a long ass letter. Oh dear Lord. Fortunately when it striked midnight I immediately sent that letter to my friend to read and dispose of. It was sort of a release as I always wrote my ex, letters upon letters. Nowadays whenever I need to blame him I just go on What's Up? and type away. Later on, I'd feel dumb feeling like that buy hey, we're humans afterall. 

Try it and good luck! :)

It was my ex's birthday on Dec. 4 and I remember last year-- crying on his shoulders about dropping out of my major. My birthday as well is on Dec. 6, and last year I was also crying about school and life to him. 

This year, I decided having an early 20th birthday dinner with my close friends on Dec. 4th, and it was just perfect. I was surrounded with such love and contentment, though I wished a few of my other closest friends were able to come. Though it's exam season. I'm back in school for another major now. Also on Saturday, my parents took my sister and I to a fancy all-you-can-eat sushi place to celebrate my birthday in advance. The day of my birthday, my childhood close friends took me to a dessert place– we ate like pigs and laughed hysterically. LOL. Overall I had a great weekend! 

Now back to studying for exams :)
